title: ARCH↔MLOPS-001: Model Deployment Topology & Flash Budget + Reproducibility/Rollback Evidence
description: The Embedded Systems Architect provides the deployment topology, the flash budget for model artifacts, the edge-vs-cloud inference split, and the OTA (Over-the-Air) strategy constraints; the MLOps Engineer provides implementation of reproducibility and deployment-safety requirements, plus evidence of model lineage and rollback capability. Grounded in EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_ARCHITECT_SKILL §6.5 and MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.5. A flash-budget exceedance or a reproducibility/safety gap is raised as an ADR (Never-Silently-Deviate); model signing / supply-chain integrity stay under MLOPS↔SEC-001, and OTA dispatch stays under MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001 / FW↔MLOPS-001.

architecture_constraints.description: ARCH→MLOPS: deployment topology, model flash budget, inference split, OTA strategy constraints.

mlops_implementation_evidence.description: MLOPS→ARCH: reproducibility/safety implementation + lineage and rollback evidence.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Deployment topology, model flash budget, inference split, and OTA strategy constraints are architecture decisions ratified by humans. A flash-budget exceedance or a reproducibility/rollback gap is raised as an ADR; binding OTA strategy changes route through the OTA chain (MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001 / FW↔MLOPS-001) and model signing through MLOPS↔SEC-001 (ESC-SEC).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (strategy alignment at planning; ADR consultation on any reproducibility/safety gap; release-gate review)
confirm_conditions: the model flash budget and measured artifact size carry explicit units
the inference split (EDGE/CLOUD/HYBRID) and deployment topology are stated
lineage evidence and verified rollback capability are provided for a production-stage model
flash_budget_conformance states within_budget; an exceedance carries an ADR reference
reject_conditions: a flash-budget or artifact-size quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a model artifact over the flash budget presented as conformant without an ADR (Never-Silently-Deviate)
rollback capability asserted without lineage/rollback evidence (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
counter_conditions: an OTA strategy change is implied — route it through the OTA chain (MLOPS↔DEVOPS-001 / FW↔MLOPS-001) with an ADR, not this constraint handoff
a reproducibility gap lacks a remediation path — request the safety-gap ADR before release-gate sign-off
